dedupe_keys.name: era5 drought global drought indices based on ecmwf reanalysis

description: ERA5–Drought: Global drought indices based on ECMWF reanalysis is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Jessica Keune et al. Droughts are increasingly intensified by human-induced climate change and pose a growing threat to society. The dataset is intended to help monitor drought occurrence and intensity. This paper introduces a new dataset of drought indices derived from the 5th generation ECMWF reanalysis system (ERA5), which offers long-term monitoring of the global climate in both deterministic and probabilistic forms. Coverage: global; published in 2025. Formats: NetCDF. The data are held in ECMWF and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
